profile.headline: Strategic Leader * Planning & Execution * Program Design Mgmt & Sustainability * Business Enablement * Client Experience Outcomes * Customer Segment Acquisition Strategies & Insights
profile.jobTitle: VP, Program Director Strategic Prioritization & Customer Journeys
profile.summary:
Tina is a strategic leader, trusted business advisor, and execution expert, with a heightened awareness of the client experience and customer journeys. Tina has solid experience leading enterprise strategic programs, standing up programs, and leading innovation initiatives end-to-end across various channels in the financial services industry. 

Throughout her career, Tina has demonstrated to be highly skilled at optimizing partnerships, implementing customer segment and acquisition strategies, and driving customer-centric solutions.

Key Strengths:
Strategy, Planning, and Execution. Leading enterprise programs; formulating and implementing long-term vision/direction/strategy to deliver maximum value to the business. Deep experience building operational frameworks that support revenue growth and customer loyalty across products and services. 

Program Management & Leadership. Track record for managing PMOs, standing up new programs from concept through adoption and sustainment, and leading high-performing teams.

Customer Growth Strategies. Applying customer acquisition strategies and product tactics, identifying emerging segments and expansion opportunities, and implementing disciplines that support growth.

Customer Loyalty. Drive customer-centric solutions, uncovering data insights, and identifying key drivers, themes, and findings to formulate recommendations and improve overall NPS.

Partnerships & Influencing. Optimizing partnerships, initiating and driving departmental changes, influencing other business lines for optimal outcomes, and facilitating enterprise-wide collaboration.

CX Methodologies. Experienced applying CX methodologies, customer journey mapping, personas, experience design, and design thinking.

Sales Enablement. Operative sales practice management and enablement for specialty sales teams, building sales engagement and client models for a more predictive customer experience.

positions.title: VP, Program Director Strategic Prioritization & Customer Journeys
positions.description:
Accountable for Strategic Prioritization and Outcomes for Commercial Bank US/Canada, providing strategic direction on advancing Customer Journeys and client-experience improvements across segments.

Manage the Customer Journey program, advancement of integration opportunities, and prioritization across the Commercial Bank, driving engagement and adoption across disciplines, sales, and channels.

Lead a high-performing team functioning as CX solution delivery and support. 

Maintain Customer Journeys for 30 different Commercial segments and identify cross-functional integration and digital opportunities that bring value to the customer and the business.  

Partner with executives, business line leaders, and support teams to ensure alignment on prioritized initiatives and translate them into work products.

Established a Prioritization Methodology and CX success measures aligning with NPS goals, drivers, and insights, and prioritization of CX improvement opportunities across business lines for optimal results (OKRs) and outcomes.
positions.insights: Strategy Consulting, Customer Segmentation Strategy and +9 skills

positions.title: Head, Premier Services Strategy & Program Management
positions.description:
Head PMO for Premier Services overseeing operations, strategic planning, delivery, build, and execution for innovation & change initiatives.

Accountable for national program management and deployment of the Premier Services segment operating model for mass-affluent clients. 
- Applying customer acquisition, growth, and retention strategies.
- Mapping out strategies for segment tiers and emerging segments, turning it to work product and sales approach and targets. 
- Operative sales practice management & enablement; implementing tactics, standards, and practices to meet KPI targets.
- Designing client-engagement models and customer journey mapping to help deliver on a predictive client-experience and net promoter score. 
- Leading value proposition initiatives; brand strategy execution.
positions.insights: Strategy Consulting, Customer Segmentation Strategy and +9 skills

positions.title: VP, Innovations Program Management
positions.description:
Managed Retail Innovations PMO and program-portfolio of branch automation initiatives across 5,600 branches. Initiatives included branch retrofits, reconfigurations, ATM installs, and signage branding. Accountable for driving program strategy, planning, design, execution, and meeting branch-go-live dates. Managed the project team, resources, and forecasting of capital spend.

Maintained program delivery framework by implementing improvements to innovation life-cycle and implementing program controls, processes, and tools to drive work to completion and with consistency across the country. Built and implemented Innovation Change Management program to manage scope change and meet program strategy, and objectives.
positions.insights: Strategy Consulting, Customer Segmentation Strategy and +10 skills

positions.title: VP, Program Manager PMO Controls
positions.description:
Commissioned to global controls task-force in leadership and SME role supporting PMO delivering on Consent Order program for regulatory compliancy (BSA/AML and OFAC) to strengthen controls within all lines of businesses and work-streams.  Leveraged extensive years of program management experience to establish program governance, controls, establish program delivery framework and drive consistency across PMO Consent Order program.

Developed and implemented BSA/AML and KYC Governance & Settlement program to demonstrate settlement and closure of all LOB open regulatory items thereby achieving compliancy, audit pass and project closure.  Built and implemented Consent Order Change Management program utilized to track scope changes impacting all books-of work across the program for 148 projects. 
 
Conducted Impact-Gap Analysis effort working with business executives and cross-functional organizations  to gather critical analysis and identify synergies and gaps for meeting regulatory compliance, collected data,  presented findings, syndicated results with business leaders, and developed launch tactical plans.
positions.insights: Business Process Improvement, Customer Insight and +2 skills

positions.title: VP, Development Program Manager
positions.description:
Led Innovations Development & Branding program. Accountable for managing brand signage development and strategy initiatives at the concept phase through pre-planning, requirements, design, engineering, prototyping, and launch to market.  Designed and implemented signage development life-cycle.

Managed national vendors overseeing prototyping, design standards, engineering, fabrication, and product quality and performance.  Implemented vendor-partner controls by establishing key performance indicators, conducting quarterly plant observations, and overseeing contractual obligations.  

Led value engineering initiatives to identify cost savings on materials, design engineering, manufacturing, and installation which amounted to 32% cost savings and efficiencies.  Conducted negotiations for vendor pricing on materials, fabrication, installation, shipping, and servicing.
